Medication reminders for the household. Free for one person. No account.

Willowbell is the one list of who takes what and when: your own tablets, a child's antibiotic three times a day, a parent's morning and evening pills. It reminds you on this phone at the times you set, records taken, skipped or missed so nobody has to wonder "did I give it already", and prints a clean medication list to hand to a doctor, a school or a pharmacist.

What you enter stays on your phone. There is nothing to sign up for.

FREE FOR ONE PERSON

- Free for one person, with unlimited medications. A one-time purchase adds everyone else.
- Every schedule type, reminders, history and the printable list are included. Not a trial.
- Nothing you have entered is ever hidden or locked.

REMINDERS THAT SHOW THEIR WORK

- Private by default: on a locked phone a reminder says only "Medicine reminder" and the time, with no medicine or person. Turn off "Hide names on the Lock Screen" in Settings if you want names shown. Tap a reminder to open Willowbell, then use Take, Skip or Snooze on Today.
- A reminder log in Settings lists every reminder Willowbell scheduled, snoozed or cancelled, and says plainly if notifications are off.
- If a dose is not recorded, one gentle repeat follows, 15 minutes later by default and at most twice. Change it or turn it off in Settings.
- Snooze is ten minutes and optional. Nothing takes over your screen unless you turn on alarms.
- On iOS 26, an optional setting ("Ring like an alarm") rings scheduled doses as alarms, even in Silent mode and Focus, with Stop and Taken buttons. Stop ends the alarm; the dose stays on Today until you record it.
- Shortcuts support: log a dose, hear what is next, or read the medicine list without opening the app.
- Add doses to Calendar, for one person or the whole household.
- Care handoff: save your medicine list as one file and bring it into Alderbook.

SCHEDULES REAL LIFE NEEDS

- Daily at set times, weekdays only, every N hours, every N days, or as needed.
- As-needed medicines get a "Log a dose" button, so two parents can see when the last dose was given.
- Missed doses are marked plainly at the next open.
- After a time zone change or a schedule edit, a dose at an old time can stay on Today for up to 24 hours beside the new times. Skip it if not needed; untaken, it is recorded as missed.

THE HOUSEHOLD

- One person or many, each with their own colour.
- Children are entries a parent makes, never users. Optional age band, never a birthdate.
- Taken doses per person per week: "Taken 27 of 28 this week".
- Share a copy: turn one person's list into a QR code or a link for another phone. You pick who gets it; Willowbell sends nothing itself, and a copy does not stay in sync.

THE PRINTABLE MED LIST

Per person or for the whole household: name, strength as you typed it, form, schedule, prescriber, pharmacy, refill date, notes. A PDF to share or print for a doctor's visit, a school form or a hospital bag.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

Willowbell stores what you type and repeats it back at the right time. It never calculates a dose, suggests a timing, checks interactions or gives medical advice, and it is not a substitute for a doctor or pharmacist. Strength is shown exactly as you entered it.

PRIVACY

Local only. No account, no email, no ads, no tracking. What you enter is stored on this phone and Willowbell never sends it anywhere; the only connection the app makes is the App Store purchase check, which runs when the app starts. Share a copy, exports and printing go only where you choose. Save a backup of everything or delete everything from Settings in two taps. Reminders are local notifications on this phone.

Medmento is a simple medication reminder with clear, persistent alerts, medication tracking and optional memory exercises.

Use it for yourself, or set it up for a parent or someone you care about who needs a little extra help remembering their medication.

No account. No ads. No premium tier. Your medication and health information stays on your device.

Designed with input from patients, doctors and dementia researchers.

MEDICATION REMINDERS THAT GET YOUR ATTENTION

• Clear, persistent reminders when it is time to take your medication
• Set several times for the same medication
• See what you need to take next at a glance
• Keep track of how much medication you have left
• Know when it is getting close to refill time

MEMORY GAMES AND MEMORY TESTING

The memory games are designed to fit into your medication routine. After confirming a dose, you can play a short memory game there and then. It makes regular memory exercise easier to fit into your day, without giving you another habit to remember.

Your scores are saved so you can follow your performance over time.

The app also includes a memory test based on the Free and Cued Selective Reminding Test (FCSRT), a well-established method for assessing episodic memory used in clinical practice and research.

Medmento's version is based on the same principles and gives you a structured way to put your memory to the test.

SIMPLE AND EASY TO FOLLOW

Medmento is made for people who want a clear medication app without unnecessary menus and complicated features.

• See your medications and upcoming doses at a glance
• Give medications familiar names that are easy to recognise
• See your next dose right from your home screen with widgets
• Dark mode for comfortable viewing in low light
• Easy to set up for yourself or someone you care about

PRIVATE, WITH NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED

Medication and health information is personal. Medmento does not require you to create an account to use the app.

• No registration
• Your medication and health information stays on your device
• Local data is protected with AES-256 encryption
• No ads
• No paid premium version

SEE HOW YOU'RE DOING OVER TIME

When you confirm that you have taken your medication, you can also answer a few simple questions about how you are feeling.

Your answers are linked to the medications you take. Over time, this can make it easier to spot patterns and give you better information to discuss with your doctor or other healthcare professional.

MADE IN NORWAY

Medmento is the successor to Medmonitor, which was developed in collaboration with Nasjonalforeningen for folkehelsen.

We kept what worked well, simplified the experience and put more emphasis on privacy, memory and making medication easier to manage in everyday life.

Medmento is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. For medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, consult a qualified healthcare professional.
